about_the_game:
3... 2... 1...

SKIJOR!

Skijoring (verb): the act of being pulled over snow or ice on skis by a horse or dog or a motor vehicle, for fun.

Welcome to Skijoring, the unhinged sport of push and pull. 

You and a friend are skijorers, seeking thrills on the wildest mountains around. Strapped to your trusty snowmobile, you'll work together to jump, trick, and boost your way to the finish.

COOPERATE!

Conquer 3 radical peaks as a team in split-screen or remote play.

Help - or hinder - your most helpless, trusting friends as you see fit.

Only through teamwork can you speed through icy caverns, high-speed luges, and deadly avalanches.


GYRATE!

Pull off stylish moves to impress the crowd. Flip and grind as the Skier, drift and boost as the Snowmobiler, and gain big air to top the scoreboard. 

A dynamic camera and music mix react to your playstyle in real time.

Challenge BLACK DIAMOND MODE, where STYLE IS SURVIVAL.


DISCOMBOBULATE!

Skijoring is all about wipeouts, wackiness, and weird plays.

Skid off the side of a mountain. Skip an entire hill. Throw your friend into a tree at 200 kph.

But watch your luck. The snowmobile can blow up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 / Windows® 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD A8-7600 / Intel® Core™ i3-3210
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® Arc™ A750 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750 AMD Radeon™ RX 590 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 / Windows® 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200 / Intel® Core™ i9 (I9-9880H)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ RX 5700XT 8GB / NVIDIA® GeForce RTX 2060 6GB
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

short_description: Crash into your friends in Skijoring, the unhinged sport of push and pull. Get wild airtime, screen-peek to survive, and embrace co-op chaos in the world's first, best, and only arcade skijorer.
